newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenyin tops brokerages in H1 Shanghai business.
newsitem.headline: Shenyin tops brokerages in H1 Shanghai business.

text.p: Shenyin & Wanguo Securities, China's biggest brokerage, topped all other domestic securities firms in stock trading on the Shanghai stock exchange in the first half of 1997, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
Shenyin & Wanguo registered combined trading turnover of stocks, state debt contracts and investment funds of 253.3 billion yuan, representing a total market share of 6.8 percent, the newspaper said.
However, the security firm's market share dropped by 5.1 percentage points from 11.9 percent for the same period last year, the newspaper said.
China Securities Co was the second biggest trader in the first half of 1997 with turnover of 133.9 billion yuan, followed by Haitong Securities on volume of 108.727 billion yuan, it said.
